w.fullDescription: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

e.name: Ethereal Chains
e.shortDescription: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit.
e.fullDescription: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

r.name: Mimic
r.shortDescription: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.
r.fullDescription: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

availability.summary: Mimic requires one of LeBlanc’s original Q, W, or E spells.

passive.name: Mirror Image
passive.shortDescription: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.
passive.fullDescription: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

body.name: Lee Sin
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 345 movement speed.

q.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
q.shortDescription: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters.
q.fullDescription:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.

Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

w.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
w.shortDescription: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage.
w.fullDescription:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.

Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

e.name: Tempest / Cripple
e.shortDescription: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit.
e.fullDescription:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.

Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

r.name: Dragon's Rage
r.shortDescription: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with.
r.fullDescription: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

passive.name: Flurry
passive.shortDescription: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.
passive.fullDescription: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

body.name: Leona
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Shield of Daybreak
q.shortDescription: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
q.fullDescription: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

w.name: Eclipse
w.shortDescription: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist.
w.fullDescription: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

e.name: Zenith Blade
e.shortDescription: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line.
e.fullDescription: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

r.name: Solar Flare
r.shortDescription: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area.
r.fullDescription: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

passive.name: Sunlight
passive.shortDescription: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds.
passive.fullDescription: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

body.name: Lillia
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 325 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Blooming Blows
q.shortDescription: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells.
q.fullDescription: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.

w.name: Watch Out! Eep!
w.shortDescription: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.
w.fullDescription: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.

e.name: Swirlseed
e.shortDescription: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on.
e.fullDescription: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.

r.name: Lilting Lullaby
r.shortDescription: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep.
r.fullDescription: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.

passive.name: Dream-Laden Bough
passive.shortDescription: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.
passive.fullDescription: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

body.name: Lissandra
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 325 movement speed.

q.name: Ice Shard
q.shortDescription: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed.
q.fullDescription: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.

w.name: Ring of Frost
w.shortDescription: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.
w.fullDescription: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.

e.name: Glacial Path
e.shortDescription: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage.
e.fullDescription: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.

r.name: Frozen Tomb
r.shortDescription: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it.
r.fullDescription: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.

passive.name: Iceborn Subjugation
passive.shortDescription: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall.
passive.fullDescription: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

body.name: Locke
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Ritual Nails
q.shortDescription: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit.
q.fullDescription: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.

w.name: Soul Ignition
w.shortDescription: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself.
w.fullDescription: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.

e.name: Ashen Pursuit
e.shortDescription: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.
e.fullDescription: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.

r.name: Purgatory
r.shortDescription: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit.
r.fullDescription: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.

passive.name: Silver Stake
passive.shortDescription: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.
passive.fullDescription: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.

body.name: Lucian
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 500 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Piercing Light
q.shortDescription: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
q.fullDescription: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

w.name: Ardent Blaze
w.shortDescription: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies.
w.fullDescription: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

e.name: Relentless Pursuit
e.shortDescription: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance.
e.fullDescription: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

r.name: The Culling
r.shortDescription: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.
r.fullDescription: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.shortDescription: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot.
passive.fullDescription: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

body.name: Lulu
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Glitterlance
q.shortDescription: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
q.fullDescription: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

w.name: Whimsy
w.shortDescription: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time.
w.fullDescription: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

e.name: Help, Pix!
e.shortDescription: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them.
e.fullDescription: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

r.name: Wild Growth
r.shortDescription: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health.
r.fullDescription: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
passive.shortDescription: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit.
passive.fullDescription: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

body.name: Lux
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Light Binding
q.shortDescription: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.
q.fullDescription: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

w.name: Prismatic Barrier
w.shortDescription: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.
w.fullDescription: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

e.name: Lucent Singularity
e.shortDescription: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies.
e.fullDescription: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

r.name: Final Spark
r.shortDescription: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area.
r.fullDescription: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

passive.name: Illumination
passive.shortDescription: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds.
passive.fullDescription: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

body.name: Malphite
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Seismic Shard
q.shortDescription: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
q.fullDescription: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.

w.name: Thunderclap
w.shortDescription: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom.
w.fullDescription: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

e.name: Ground Slam
e.shortDescription: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
e.fullDescription: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

r.name: Unstoppable Force
r.shortDescription: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
r.fullDescription: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.shortDescription: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health.
passive.fullDescription: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

body.name: Malzahar
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 500 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Call of the Void
q.shortDescription: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void.
q.fullDescription: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

w.name: Void Swarm
w.shortDescription: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.
w.fullDescription: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

e.name: Malefic Visions
e.shortDescription: Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time.
e.fullDescription:
Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.

If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.

r.name: Nether Grasp
r.shortDescription: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.
r.fullDescription: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

passive.name: Void Shift
passive.shortDescription: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.
passive.fullDescription: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

body.name: Maokai
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Bramble Smash
q.shortDescription: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.
q.fullDescription: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

w.name: Twisted Advance
w.shortDescription: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target.
w.fullDescription: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

e.name: Sapling Toss
e.shortDescription: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard.
e.fullDescription: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

r.name: Nature's Grasp
r.shortDescription: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.
r.fullDescription: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

passive.name: Sap Magic
passive.shortDescription: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown.
passive.fullDescription: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

body.name: Master Yi
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 355 movement speed.

q.name: Alpha Strike
q.shortDescription: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable.
q.fullDescription: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

w.name: Meditate
w.shortDescription: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time.
w.fullDescription: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.

e.name: Wuju Style
e.shortDescription: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.
e.fullDescription: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.

r.name: Highlander
r.shortDescription: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects.
r.fullDescription: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

passive.name: Double Strike
passive.shortDescription: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.
passive.fullDescription: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.

body.name: Mel
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Radiant Volley
q.shortDescription: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.
q.fullDescription: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.

w.name: Rebuttal
w.shortDescription: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.
w.fullDescription: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

e.name: Solar Snare
e.shortDescription: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.
e.fullDescription: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

r.name: Golden Eclipse
r.shortDescription: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.
r.fullDescription:
Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.

Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

availability.summary: Golden Eclipse requires Overwhelm marks supplied by Mel’s original Passive.

passive.name: Searing Brilliance
passive.shortDescription: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.
passive.fullDescription:
Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.

When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

body.name: Milio
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 525 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
q.shortDescription: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy.
q.fullDescription: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

w.name: Cozy Campfire
w.shortDescription: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside.
w.fullDescription: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

e.name: Warm Hugs
e.shortDescription: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed.
e.fullDescription: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

r.name: Breath of Life
r.shortDescription: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
r.fullDescription: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.shortDescription: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.
passive.fullDescription: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

body.name: Miss Fortune
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 325 movement speed.

q.name: Double Up
q.shortDescription: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them.
q.fullDescription: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

w.name: Strut
w.shortDescription: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked.
w.fullDescription: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.

e.name: Make It Rain
e.shortDescription: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
e.fullDescription: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

r.name: Bullet Time
r.shortDescription: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies.
r.fullDescription: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

passive.name: Love Tap
passive.shortDescription: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.
passive.fullDescription: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

body.name: Wukong
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Crushing Blow
q.shortDescription: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.
q.fullDescription: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

w.name: Warrior Trickster
w.shortDescription: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.
w.fullDescription: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

e.name: Nimbus Strike
e.shortDescription: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.
e.fullDescription: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

r.name: Cyclone
r.shortDescription: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.
r.fullDescription:
Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.

Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.shortDescription: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.
passive.fullDescription: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

body.name: Mordekaiser
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Obliterate
q.shortDescription: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck.
q.fullDescription: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

w.name: Indestructible
w.shortDescription: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield.
w.fullDescription: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

e.name: Death's Grasp
e.shortDescription: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.
e.fullDescription: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

r.name: Realm of Death
r.shortDescription: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats.
r.fullDescription: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

passive.name: Darkness Rise
passive.shortDescription: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.
passive.fullDescription: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

body.name: Morgana
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 450 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Dark Binding
q.shortDescription: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.
q.fullDescription: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.

w.name: Tormented Shadow
w.shortDescription: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle.
w.fullDescription: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.

e.name: Black Shield
e.shortDescription: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.
e.fullDescription: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.

r.name: Soul Shackles
r.shortDescription: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground.
r.fullDescription: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.

passive.name: Soul Siphon
passive.shortDescription: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.
passive.fullDescription: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

body.name: Naafiri
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Darkin Daggers
q.shortDescription: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.
q.fullDescription:
Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.

w.name: The Call of the Pack
w.shortDescription: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
w.fullDescription: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.shortDescription: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health.
passive.fullDescription: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

body.name: Sivir
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 500 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Boomerang Blade
q.shortDescription: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
q.fullDescription: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

w.name: Ricochet
w.shortDescription: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
w.fullDescription: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

e.name: Spell Shield
e.shortDescription: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir.
e.fullDescription: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

r.name: On The Hunt
r.shortDescription: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time.
r.fullDescription: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.shortDescription: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
passive.fullDescription: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

body.name: Skarner
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 150 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
q.shortDescription: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.
q.fullDescription: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

w.name: Seismic Bastion
w.shortDescription: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.
w.fullDescription: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

e.name: Ixtal's Impact
e.shortDescription: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain.
e.fullDescription: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

r.name: Impale
r.shortDescription: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions.
r.fullDescription: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

passive.name: Threads of Vibration
passive.shortDescription: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking.
passive.fullDescription: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

body.name: Smolder
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Super Scorcher Breath
q.shortDescription: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy.
q.fullDescription: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

w.name: Achooo!
w.shortDescription: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.
w.fullDescription: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

e.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
e.shortDescription: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.
e.fullDescription: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

r.name: MMOOOMMMM!
r.shortDescription: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
r.fullDescription: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.shortDescription: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice.
passive.fullDescription: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

availability.summary: Dragon Practice only increases damage for Smolder’s other basic abilities.

body.name: Sona
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 325 movement speed.

q.name: Hymn of Valor
q.shortDescription: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters.
q.fullDescription: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

w.name: Aria of Perseverance
w.shortDescription: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally.
w.fullDescription: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

e.name: Song of Celerity
e.shortDescription: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed.
e.fullDescription: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

r.name: Crescendo
r.shortDescription: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.
r.fullDescription: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

passive.name: Power Chord
passive.shortDescription: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap.
passive.fullDescription:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

body.name: Soraka
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 325 movement speed.

q.name: Starcall
q.shortDescription: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies.
q.fullDescription: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

w.name: Astral Infusion
w.shortDescription: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.
w.fullDescription: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

e.name: Equinox
e.shortDescription: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside.
e.fullDescription: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

r.name: Wish
r.shortDescription: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.
r.fullDescription: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

passive.name: Salvation
passive.shortDescription: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.
passive.fullDescription: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

body.name: Swain
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 525 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Death's Hand
q.shortDescription: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies.
q.fullDescription: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

w.name: Vision of Empire
w.shortDescription: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies.
w.fullDescription: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

e.name: Nevermove
e.shortDescription: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward.
e.fullDescription: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

r.name: Demonic Ascension
r.shortDescription: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters.
r.fullDescription: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.shortDescription: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.
passive.fullDescription: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

body.name: Sylas
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Chain Lash
q.shortDescription: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies.
q.fullDescription:
Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies.

After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

w.name: Kingslayer
w.shortDescription: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.
w.fullDescription: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

e.name: Abscond / Abduct
e.shortDescription: Sylas dashes to a location.
e.fullDescription: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

r.name: Hijack
r.shortDescription: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.
r.fullDescription: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

passive.name: Petricite Burst
passive.shortDescription: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst.
passive.fullDescription: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

body.name: Syndra
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Dark Sphere
q.shortDescription: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage.
q.fullDescription: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

w.name: Force of Will
w.shortDescription: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.
w.fullDescription: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

e.name: Scatter the Weak
e.shortDescription: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage.
e.fullDescription: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

r.name: Unleashed Power
r.shortDescription: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.
r.fullDescription: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

passive.name: Transcendent
passive.shortDescription: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.
passive.fullDescription:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge

Force of Will: Bonus true damage.

Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets

Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

availability.summary: Transcendent only upgrades Syndra’s other abilities.

body.name: Tahm Kench
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Tongue Lash
q.shortDescription: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.
q.fullDescription:
Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.

Applies a stack of  An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.

w.name: Abyssal Dive
w.shortDescription: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.
w.fullDescription: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.

e.name: Thick Skin
e.shortDescription: Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat.
e.fullDescription:
Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat.

Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.

r.name: Devour
r.shortDescription: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.
r.fullDescription: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.

passive.name: An Acquired Taste
passive.shortDescription: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health.
passive.fullDescription: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.

body.name: Taliyah
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 525 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Threaded Volley
q.shortDescription: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts.
q.fullDescription: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.

w.name: Seismic Shove
w.shortDescription: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.
w.fullDescription: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

e.name: Unraveled Earth
e.shortDescription: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield.
e.fullDescription: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.

r.name: Weaver's Wall
r.shortDescription: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.
r.fullDescription: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.

passive.name: Rock Surfing
passive.shortDescription: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.
passive.fullDescription: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

body.name: Talon
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Noxian Diplomacy
q.shortDescription: Talon stabs the target unit.
q.fullDescription: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

w.name: Rake
w.shortDescription: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy.
w.fullDescription: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

e.name: Assassin's Path
e.shortDescription: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance.
e.fullDescription: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

r.name: Shadow Assault
r.shortDescription: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed.
r.fullDescription: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

passive.name: Blade's End
passive.shortDescription: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times.
passive.fullDescription: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

body.name: Taric
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 150 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Starlight's Touch
q.shortDescription: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored.
q.fullDescription: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.

w.name: Bastion
w.shortDescription: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.
w.fullDescription:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

e.name: Dazzle
e.shortDescription: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
e.fullDescription: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.

r.name: Cosmic Radiance
r.shortDescription: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
r.fullDescription: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

passive.name: Bravado
passive.shortDescription: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.
passive.fullDescription: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

body.name: Teemo
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 500 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Blinding Dart
q.shortDescription: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.
q.fullDescription: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

w.name: Move Quick
w.shortDescription: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret.
w.fullDescription: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

e.name: Toxic Shot
e.shortDescription: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.
e.fullDescription: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

r.name: Noxious Trap
r.shortDescription: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack.
r.fullDescription: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

passive.name: Guerrilla Warfare
passive.shortDescription: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely.
passive.fullDescription: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

body.name: Thresh
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 450 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Death Sentence
q.shortDescription: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him.
q.fullDescription: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.

w.name: Dark Passage
w.shortDescription: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage.
w.fullDescription: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.

e.name: Flay
e.shortDescription: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks.
e.fullDescription: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.

r.name: The Box
r.shortDescription: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
r.fullDescription: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.

passive.name: Damnation
passive.shortDescription: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.
passive.fullDescription: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

body.name: Tristana
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 325 movement speed.

q.name: Rapid Fire
q.shortDescription: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.
q.fullDescription: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

w.name: Rocket Jump
w.shortDescription: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.
w.fullDescription: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

e.name: Explosive Charge
e.shortDescription: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies.
e.fullDescription: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

r.name: Buster Shot
r.shortDescription: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit.
r.fullDescription: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

passive.name: Draw a Bead
passive.shortDescription: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.
passive.fullDescription: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

body.name: Trundle
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 350 movement speed.

q.name: Chomp
q.shortDescription: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.
q.fullDescription: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

w.name: Frozen Domain
w.shortDescription: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.
w.fullDescription: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

e.name: Pillar of Ice
e.shortDescription: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.
e.fullDescription: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

r.name: Subjugate
r.shortDescription: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance.
r.fullDescription: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.shortDescription: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.
passive.fullDescription: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

body.name: Tryndamere
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 345 movement speed.

q.name: Bloodlust
q.shortDescription: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded.
q.fullDescription: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

w.name: Mocking Shout
w.shortDescription: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage.
w.fullDescription: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

e.name: Spinning Slash
e.shortDescription: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
e.fullDescription: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

r.name: Undying Rage
r.shortDescription: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
r.fullDescription: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.shortDescription: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes.
passive.fullDescription: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

body.name: Twisted Fate
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 525 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Wild Cards
q.shortDescription: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.
q.fullDescription: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

w.name: Pick a Card
w.shortDescription: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.
w.fullDescription: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

e.name: Stacked Deck
e.shortDescription: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage.
e.fullDescription: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.

r.name: Destiny
r.shortDescription: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.
r.fullDescription: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

passive.name: Loaded Dice
passive.shortDescription: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.
passive.fullDescription: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

body.name: Twitch
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Ambush
q.shortDescription: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed.
q.fullDescription:
Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.

When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

w.name: Venom Cask
w.shortDescription: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
w.fullDescription: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

e.name: Contaminate
e.shortDescription: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
e.fullDescription: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

availability.summary: Contaminate requires Deadly Venom stacks supplied by Twitch’s original kit.

r.name: Spray and Pray
r.shortDescription: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
r.fullDescription: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.shortDescription: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.
passive.fullDescription: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.

body.name: Udyr
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 350 movement speed.

q.name: Wilding Claw
q.shortDescription: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage.
q.fullDescription: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.

w.name: Iron Mantle
w.shortDescription: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him.
w.fullDescription: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.

e.name: Blazing Stampede
e.shortDescription: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them.

r.fullDescription: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

e.shortDescription: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted.
e.fullDescription: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.

r.name: Transcend One's Self
r.shortDescription: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.
r.fullDescription: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.
