passive.shortDescription: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.
passive.fullDescription: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.

body.name: Yuumi
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 425 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Prowling Projectile
q.shortDescription: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit.
q.fullDescription:
Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally.

While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period.

w.name: You and Me!
w.shortDescription: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets.
w.fullDescription: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets. While on her Best Friend, she gains Heal & Shield Power and grants her Ally On-Hit healing.

e.name: Zoomies
e.shortDescription: Shields Yuumi and boosts Move Speed and Attack Speed.
e.fullDescription: Shields Yuumi and boosts Move Speed and Attack Speed. If she's attached, she passes it to her ally instead.

r.name: Final Chapter
r.shortDescription: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies.
r.fullDescription: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies. Yuumi can move, attach, and cast Zoomies! while channeling. While on her Best Friend, this spell also follows her mouse.

passive.name: Feline Friendship
passive.shortDescription: Periodically, when Yuumi strikes a champion with an attack or ability, she restores health to herself and the next ally she Attaches to.
passive.fullDescription:
Periodically, when Yuumi strikes a champion with an attack or ability, she restores health to herself and the next ally she Attaches to.

While Attached, Yuumi generates a special bond with her allies. The ally with the strongest bond enhances Yuumi's abilities while she is Attached to them.

body.name: Zaahen
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 345 movement speed.

q.name: The Darkin Glaive
q.shortDescription: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself.
q.fullDescription: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.

w.name: Dreaded Return
w.shortDescription: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.
w.fullDescription: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.

e.name: Aureate Rush
e.shortDescription: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.
e.fullDescription: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.

r.name: Grim Deliverance
r.shortDescription: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
r.fullDescription: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

passive.name: Cultivation of War
passive.shortDescription: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions  grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack.
passive.fullDescription: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions  grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

body.name: Zac
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 175 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Stretching Strikes
q.shortDescription: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy.
q.fullDescription: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

w.name: Unstable Matter
w.shortDescription: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.
w.fullDescription: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.

e.name: Elastic Slingshot
e.shortDescription: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.
e.fullDescription: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

r.name: Let's Bounce!
r.shortDescription: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.
r.fullDescription: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.

passive.name: Cell Division
passive.shortDescription: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health.
passive.fullDescription: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets. Each bloblet has a percentage of Zac's maximum Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. This ability has a 5 minute cooldown.

body.name: Zed
body.fullDescription: Base stats, melee attack type, 125 attack range, and 345 movement speed.

q.name: Razor Shuriken
q.shortDescription: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.
q.fullDescription:
Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.

Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

w.name: Living Shadow
w.shortDescription: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability.
w.fullDescription:
Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability.

Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

e.name: Shadow Slash
e.shortDescription: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
e.fullDescription: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.

r.name: Death Mark
r.shortDescription: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them.
r.fullDescription: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.

passive.name: Contempt for the Weak
passive.shortDescription: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage.
passive.fullDescription: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.

body.name: Zeri
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 330 movement speed.

q.name: Burst Fire
q.shortDescription: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit.
q.fullDescription: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.

w.name: Ultrashock Laser
w.shortDescription: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit.
w.fullDescription: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit. If the pulse hits a wall it expands into a long range laser.

e.name: Spark Surge
e.shortDescription: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies.
e.fullDescription: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies. She will vault and grind over any terrain she touches.

r.name: Lightning Crash
r.shortDescription: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion.
r.fullDescription: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.

passive.name: Living Battery
passive.shortDescription: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities.
passive.fullDescription: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Moving and casting Burst Fire stores up energy in Zeri's Sparkpack. When fully charged her next Attack deals bonus damage.

body.name: Ziggs
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 325 movement speed.

q.name: Bouncing Bomb
q.shortDescription: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.
q.fullDescription: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

w.name: Satchel Charge
w.shortDescription: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again.
w.fullDescription:
Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage.

Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

e.name: Hexplosive Minefield
e.shortDescription: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing.
e.fullDescription: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.

r.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
r.shortDescription: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance.
r.fullDescription: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away.

passive.name: Short Fuse
passive.shortDescription: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage.
passive.fullDescription: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

body.name: Zilean
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 335 movement speed.

q.name: Time Bomb
q.shortDescription: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions).
q.fullDescription: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.

w.name: Rewind
w.shortDescription: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.
w.fullDescription: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.

availability.summary: Reduces the cooldowns of the composite champion’s other basic abilities.

e.name: Time Warp
e.shortDescription: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.
e.fullDescription: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.

r.name: Chronoshift
r.shortDescription: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.
r.fullDescription: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.

passive.name: Time In A Bottle
passive.shortDescription: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies.
passive.fullDescription: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

body.name: Zoe
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 550 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Paddle Star!
q.shortDescription: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight.
q.fullDescription: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

w.name: Spell Thief
w.shortDescription: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself.
w.fullDescription: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

e.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
e.shortDescription: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep.
e.fullDescription: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

r.name: Portal Jump
r.shortDescription: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second.
r.fullDescription: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.

passive.name: More Sparkles!
passive.shortDescription: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.
passive.fullDescription: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

body.name: Zyra
body.fullDescription: Base stats, ranged attack type, 575 attack range, and 340 movement speed.

q.name: Deadly Spines
q.shortDescription: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area.
q.fullDescription: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. If cast near a seed, Deadly Spines grows a Thorn Spitter plant, which fires at enemies from afar.

w.name: Rampant Growth
w.shortDescription: Zyra plants a seed, lasting up to 60 seconds.
w.fullDescription: Zyra plants a seed, lasting up to 60 seconds. Deadly Spines and Grasping Roots cast near seeds will turn them into plants who fight for Zyra. Zyra can store multiple seeds at once, and killing enemies reduces Rampant Growth's recharge time.

e.name: Grasping Roots
e.shortDescription: Zyra sends forth vines through the ground to ensnare her target, dealing damage and rooting enemies they come across.
e.fullDescription: Zyra sends forth vines through the ground to ensnare her target, dealing damage and rooting enemies they come across. If cast near a seed, Grasping Roots grows a Vine Lasher, whose short range attacks reduce enemy Move Speed.

r.name: Stranglethorns
r.shortDescription: Zyra summons a twisted thicket at her target location, dealing damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts.
r.fullDescription: Zyra summons a twisted thicket at her target location, dealing damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts. Plants within the thicket are enraged.

passive.name: Garden of Thorns
passive.shortDescription: Seeds spawn around Zyra periodically, becoming faster with level.
passive.fullDescription: Seeds spawn around Zyra periodically, becoming faster with level. Zyra can cast Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots near seeds to grow plants, who fight for Zyra.

availability.summary: Garden of Thorns requires Zyra’s Q or E to grow its seeds into plants.
